language.note: Maltese is the only Semitic language written in the Latin alphabet, and the only Semitic language with official EU status

terrainDescription.zh: 由石灰岩構成的小型群島，地勢低平、幾乎全境高度開發，呈現特有的米黃/淺黃色岩石景觀
terrainDescription.en: A small limestone archipelago, low-lying and almost entirely built up, with a distinctive pale beige/yellow rock landscape

historicalContext.zh: 馬爾他曾為英國殖民地（1964年獨立），因此靠左行駛且深受英式道路系統影響，交通標誌同時混用英式與（左駕鏡射版本的）義大利式設計；馬爾他語是唯一以拉丁字母書寫、且為歐盟官方語言的閃語族語言，是相當獨特的語言學特徵。
historicalContext.en: Malta was a British colony until 1964, hence its left-hand traffic and deeply UK-influenced road system, though British- and (left-mirrored) Italian-style signs coexist. Maltese is linguistically unique: the only Semitic language written in the Latin alphabet and the only Semitic language with EU-official status.
